preview-des-content-bikeMap: A map service for cycling trips. Search for nearby rental stations by city or by your current location, with real-time counts of available bikes and free docks. You can also look up cycling routes in each city, and nearby attractions, restaurants, hotels and events are marked on the map. Works as a PWA, so it can be added to your phone's home screen.
preview-des-content-randomWorld: An interactive generative art piece made with p5.js. As you move the mouse, shapes in random forms and colors grow across the canvas; click to switch between four modes: circles, squares, triangles and a mix. No two drawings are ever the same.
preview-des-content-colorsDove: A low poly dove drawn with p5.js. The whole dove is made of more than seventy triangles, and every click picks random colors from three palettes, creating a dove with a different style each time.
preview-des-content-dynamicTable: Visualizes the dynamic programming process of the Longest Common Subsequence (LCS). Enter two strings and the table shows each cell's value and the direction it came from (↖ ↑ ←), then traces back to the LCS, making an abstract algorithm easy to follow.
preview-des-content-aiApproval: An AI pre-review system for enterprise approval workflows. After a request is submitted, a rule engine first checks the explicit policies, then Claude interprets what needs understanding, flags the risk level and cites the relevant policy clauses, so managers only need to confirm. Supports policy PDF import, hybrid retrieval, PII masking and prompt injection protection, with an evaluation set to measure AI accuracy.
